<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Glory Asuquo | Content Systems for Coaches &amp; Consultants</title>
<meta name="description" content="I build the content system that turns your expertise into booked calls, for coaches and consultants who are tired of posting into the void.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Big+Shoulders+Display:wght@600;700;800;900&family=Source+Serif+4:ital,opsz,wght@0,8..60,400;0,8..60,500;0,8..60,600;1,8..60,400&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#102B31;
    --ink-soft:#1B3D44;
    --parchment:#F7F5F0;
    --parchment-dim:#E6E1D6;
    --white:#FFFFFF;
    --amber:#1E7E8D;
    --amber-deep:#145F6B;
    --forest:#C9992E;
    --forest-deep:#96731C;
    --stone:#7A8481;
    --stone-dark:#4B5654;
    --teal-soft:#E4F1F0;

    --display: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif;
    --body: 'Source Serif 4', serif;
    --mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    background:var(--parchment);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:var(--body);
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
  a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
  ul{list-style:none;}

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{animation-duration:0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important;}
  }

  .wrap{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 32px;}
  @media (max-width:640px){ .wrap{padding:0 20px;} }

  .eyebrow{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--forest-deep);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{
    content:"";
    width:22px; height:1px;
    background:var(--forest-deep);
    display:inline-block;
  }

  h1,h2,h3{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-weight:800;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.005em;
    line-height:0.95;
    color:var(--ink);
  }

  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:13.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:15px 26px;
    border-radius:3px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--ink);
    transition:transform .18s ease, background .18s ease, color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .btn-primary{
    background:var(--amber);
    color:var(--white);
    border-color:var(--amber);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover{
    background:var(--ink);
    color:var(--amber);
    border-color:var(--ink);
    transform:translateY(-2px);
  }
  .btn-ghost{
    background:transparent;
    color:var(--ink);
    border-color:var(--stone);
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover{
    border-color:var(--ink);
    transform:translateY(-2px);
  }
  .btn-ghost-light{
    background:transparent;
    color:var(--parchment);
    border-color:rgba(247,245,240,0.4);
  }
  .btn-ghost-light:hover{
    border-color:var(--parchment);
    background:rgba(247,245,240,0.08);
  }

  /* ===== NAV ===== */
  header{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:100;
    background:rgba(247,245,240,0.92);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(16,43,49,0.1);
  }
  nav.wrap{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding-top:18px; padding-bottom:18px;
  }
  .brand{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:20px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
  }
  .brand span{color:var(--amber-deep);}
  .navlinks{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:30px;}
  .navlinks a{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    transition:color .15s ease;
  }
  .navlinks a:hover{color:var(--ink);}
  .navcta{display:none;}
  @media (min-width:860px){ .navcta{display:inline-flex;} }
  .navlinks{display:none;}
  @media (min-width:860px){ .navlinks{display:flex;} }
  .navmobile-btn{display:inline-flex;}
  @media (min-width:860px){ .navmobile-btn{display:none;} }

  .navmobile-group{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px;}
  @media (min-width:860px){ .navmobile-group{display:none;} }

  .navmenu-toggle{
    width:34px; height:34px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:5px;
    background:transparent;
    border:1px solid var(--stone);
    border-radius:3px;
    cursor:pointer;
    padding:0;
  }
  .navmenu-toggle span{
    display:block;
    width:16px; height:2px;
    background:var(--ink);
    transition:transform .2s ease, opacity .2s ease;
  }
  .navmenu-toggle.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);}
  .navmenu-toggle.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0;}
  .navmenu-toggle.open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);}

  .navlinks-mobile{
    display:none;
    flex-direction:column;
    background:var(--parchment);
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(16,43,49,0.1);
    max-height:0;
    overflow:hidden;
    transition:max-height .25s ease;
  }
  .navlinks-mobile.open{
    display:flex;
    max-height:420px;
  }
  .navlinks-mobile li{border-top:1px solid rgba(16,43,49,0.08);}
  .navlinks-mobile a{
    display:block;
    padding:16px 20px;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--stone-dark);
  }
  @media (min-width:860px){ .navlinks-mobile{display:none !important;} }

  /* ===== HERO ===== */
  .hero{
    padding:88px 0 40px;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:0.75fr 1fr;
    gap:56px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

  .hero-photo{
    width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:4/5;
    object-fit:cover;
    border-radius:6px;
    border:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .hero-photo{max-width:280px; margin:0 auto;} }

  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(40px, 6.2vw, 74px);
    margin:18px 0 22px;
  }
  .hero h1 em{
    font-style:normal;
    color:var(--amber-deep);
  }
  .hero p.sub{
    font-size:18px;
    max-width:46ch;
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    margin-bottom:32px;
  }
  .hero-ctas{display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap;}

  /* ===== VIDEO INTRO ===== */
  .video-section{
    padding:80px 0;
  }
  .video-wrap{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:0.8fr 1.2fr;
    gap:48px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .video-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .video-intro h2{
    font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,40px);
    margin-top:14px;
  }
  .video-intro p{
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    font-size:16px;
    margin-top:14px;
    max-width:44ch;
  }
  .video-frame{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:16/9;
    background:var(--ink);
    border-radius:6px;
    overflow:hidden;
    border:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
  }
  .video-frame iframe{
    position:absolute;
    top:0; left:0;
    width:100%; height:100%;
    border:0;
  }
  .video-frame .video-placeholder{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:14px;
    color:var(--parchment-dim);
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    text-align:center;
    padding:20px;
  }
  .video-placeholder .play-ring{
    width:56px; height:56px;
    border-radius:50%;
    border:2px solid var(--amber);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    color:var(--amber);
    font-size:18px;
  }

  /* ===== SECTION SHELL ===== */
  section{padding:96px 0; scroll-margin-top:88px;}
  .section-head{
    max-width:640px;
    margin-bottom:52px;
  }
  .section-head h2{
    font-size:clamp(30px, 4vw, 44px);
    margin-top:14px;
  }
  .section-head p{
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    font-size:16.5px;
    margin-top:14px;
    max-width:56ch;
  }

  .dark{background:var(--amber); color:var(--white);}
  .dark h2, .dark h3{color:var(--white);}
  .dark .section-head p{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.82);}
  .dark .eyebrow{color:var(--white);}
  .dark .eyebrow::before{background:var(--white);}

  .teal-wash{background:var(--teal-soft);}

  /* ===== ABOUT ===== */
  .about-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:0.85fr 1.15fr;
    gap:56px;
    align-items:start;
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .about-photo{
    width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:4/5;
    object-fit:cover;
    object-position:top center;
    border-radius:5px;
    margin-bottom:20px;
    border:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
  }

  .about-card{
    background:var(--white);
    border:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:26px;
  }
  .about-card .badge{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--forest-deep);
    background:rgba(201,153,46,0.12);
    display:inline-block;
    padding:6px 10px;
    border-radius:3px;
    margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .about-card p{font-size:15.5px; color:var(--stone-dark); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .about-stats{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:14px;
    margin-top:24px;
  }
  .about-stats .stat{
    border-top:2px solid var(--amber);
    padding-top:10px;
  }
  .about-stats .num{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:28px;
    font-weight:800;
  }
  .about-stats .lbl{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:10px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    color:var(--stone);
  }

  .about-body p{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:18px; max-width:60ch;}
  .pull{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-weight:700;
    text-transform:none;
    font-size:24px;
    line-height:1.35;
    color:var(--forest-deep);
    border-left:3px solid var(--amber);
    padding-left:20px;
    margin:28px 0;
  }
  .about-tags{
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:10px;
    margin-top:8px;
  }
  .tag{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:11.5px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
    border:1px solid var(--stone);
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    padding:6px 12px;
    border-radius:20px;
  }

  /* ===== SERVICES ===== */
  .services-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px,1fr));
    gap:1px;
    background:var(--parchment-dim);
    border:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
  }
  .service-card{
    background:var(--parchment);
    padding:32px 26px;
    transition:background .18s ease;
  }
  .service-card:hover{background:var(--white);}
  .service-num{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--amber-deep);
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }
  .service-card h3{
    font-size:19px;
    text-transform:none;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:0;
    margin-bottom:10px;
    line-height:1.2;
  }
  .service-card p{
    font-size:14.5px;
    color:var(--stone-dark);
  }
  .dark .service-card p{color:var(--stone-dark);}
  .dark .service-card h3{color:var(--ink);}

  /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
  .testi-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px,1fr));
    gap:24px;
  }
  .testi-card{
    background:var(--ink-soft);
    border-radius:5px;
    padding:30px;
    border-left:3px solid var(--amber);
  }
  .testi-card p.quote{
    font-size:17px;
    font-style:italic;
    color:var(--parchment);
    margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .testi-who{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline;}
  .testi-who .name{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--white); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em;}
  .testi-who .role{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--parchment-dim);}

  /* ===== PROCESS ===== */
  .process-list{
    border-top:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
  }
  .process-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:70px 270px 1fr;
    gap:24px;
    padding:26px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
    align-items:baseline;
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .process-row{grid-template-columns:60px 1fr; }
    .process-row .proc-desc{grid-column:2; padding-top:6px;}
  }
  .process-row .num{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:30px;
    font-weight:800;
    color:var(--parchment-dim);
    -webkit-text-stroke:1px var(--white);
    color:transparent;
  }
  .process-row h3{
    font-size:19px;
    text-transform:none;
    letter-spacing:0;
    font-weight:700;
    align-self:center;
    line-height:1.25;
  }
  .optional-tag{
    display:inline-block;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-weight:500;
    color:var(--amber);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
    padding:3px 8px;
    border-radius:20px;
    vertical-align:middle;
    margin-left:8px;
  }
  .process-row p{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--stone-dark);}
  .dark .process-row p{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.78);}

  /* ===== FAQ ===== */
  .faq-list{
    border-top:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
    max-width:800px;
  }
  .faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);}
  .faq-question{
    width:100%;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:20px;
    background:none;
    border:none;
    padding:22px 4px;
    text-align:left;
    cursor:pointer;
    font-family:var(--body);
    font-size:16.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .faq-icon{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    width:26px; height:26px;
    border-radius:50%;
    border:1px solid var(--stone);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:15px;
    color:var(--amber-deep);
    transition:transform .2s ease, background .2s ease, color .2s ease;
  }
  .faq-item.open .faq-icon{
    transform:rotate(45deg);
    background:var(--amber);
    color:var(--white);
    border-color:var(--amber);
  }
  .faq-answer{
    max-height:0;
    overflow:hidden;
    transition:max-height .25s ease;
  }
  .faq-item.open .faq-answer{max-height:200px;}
  .faq-answer p{
    padding:0 4px 22px;
    font-size:15px;
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    max-width:65ch;
  }

  /* ===== PRICING ===== */
  .pricing-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap:24px;
    align-items:stretch;
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .pricing-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .price-card{
    background:var(--white);
    border:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:32px 28px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    position:relative;
  }
  .price-card.featured{
    border:2px solid var(--amber);
    box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(16,43,49,0.1);
  }
  .price-badge{
    position:absolute;
    top:-13px;
    left:28px;
    background:var(--amber);
    color:var(--white);
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:10.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:5px 12px;
    border-radius:20px;
  }
  .price-tier{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--amber-deep);
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .price-amount{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:40px;
    font-weight:800;
    color:var(--ink);
    margin-bottom:12px;
  }
  .price-amount span{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:14px;
    font-weight:500;
    color:var(--stone);
    text-transform:none;
    letter-spacing:0;
  }
  .price-desc{
    font-size:14.5px;
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    margin-bottom:20px;
    min-height:42px;
  }
  .price-features{
    list-style:none;
    margin-bottom:24px;
    flex-grow:1;
  }
  .price-features li{
    font-size:14px;
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    padding:9px 0;
    border-top:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
    padding-left:22px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .price-features li:first-child{border-top:none;}
  .price-features li::before{
    content:"+";
    position:absolute;
    left:0;
    top:9px;
    color:var(--amber-deep);
    font-weight:700;
  }
  .price-note{
    text-align:center;
    font-size:14px;
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    margin-top:32px;
  }

  /* ===== CERTIFICATIONS ===== */
  .cert-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px,1fr));
    gap:24px;
  }
  .cert-card{
    display:block;
    background:var(--white);
    border:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
    border-radius:6px;
    overflow:hidden;
    transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  }
  .cert-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(16,43,49,0.1);
  }
  .cert-card img{
    width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:4/3;
    object-fit:cover;
    object-position:top center;
    display:block;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
    background:var(--parchment);
  }
  .cert-info{padding:18px 20px;}
  .cert-info h3{
    font-size:16px;
    text-transform:none;
    letter-spacing:0;
    font-weight:700;
    margin-bottom:4px;
  }
  .cert-info p{
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    font-family:var(--mono);
  }

  /* ===== FINAL CTA ===== */
  .final-cta{
    text-align:center;
    padding:100px 0;
  }
  .final-cta h2{
    font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,54px);
    max-width:16ch;
    margin:16px auto 20px;
  }
  .final-cta p{
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    max-width:48ch;
    margin:0 auto 32px;
    font-size:16.5px;
  }
  .contact-row{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:26px;
    margin-top:36px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:12.5px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
  }

  .cal-embed-wrap{
    margin-top:48px;
    text-align:left;
    background:var(--white);
    border:1px solid var(--parchment-dim);
    border-radius:6px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .cal-embed-cap{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--amber-deep);
    padding:16px 20px 0;
  }
  #my-cal-inline{
    width:100%;
    height:680px;
    overflow:auto;
  }
  @media (max-width:640px){
    #my-cal-inline{height:820px;}
  }
  .contact-row a{
    color:var(--stone-dark);
    border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
    transition:border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease;
  }

Within weeks her page looked like a business again. That's when I understood what I was actually good at, not writing captions, building what's underneath them.</p>

You know your field, you have the results and the stories, what's missing is the infrastructure that turns that into content people can find, trust, and book from. That's what I build: the pillars, the calendar, the automations, so growth stops depending on inspiration showing up.</p>

<script>
  // Cal.com inline calendar embed
  (function (C, A, L) {
    let p = function (a, ar) { a.q.push(ar); };
    let d = C.document;
    C.Cal = C.Cal || function () {
      let cal = C.Cal;
      let ar = arguments;
      if (!cal.loaded) {
        cal.ns = {};
        cal.q = cal.q || [];
        d.head.appendChild(d.createElement("script")).src = A;
        cal.loaded = true;
      }
      if (ar[0] === L) {
        const api = function () { p(api, arguments); };
        const namespace = ar[1];
        api.q = api.q || [];
        if (typeof namespace === "string") {
          cal.ns[namespace] = cal.ns[namespace] || api;
          p(cal.ns[namespace], ar);
          p(cal, ["initNamespace", namespace]);
        } else p(cal, ar);
        return;
      }
      p(cal, ar);
    };
  })(window, "https://app.cal.com/embed/embed.js", "init");

  Cal("init", "30min", {origin: "https://cal.com"});

  Cal.ns["30min"]("inline", {
    elementOrSelector: "#my-cal-inline",
    config: {"layout": "month_view"},
    calLink: "glory-asuquo-val6vx/30min",
  });

  Cal.ns["30min"]("ui", {
    "styles": {"branding": {"brandColor": "#1E7E8D"}},
    "hideEventTypeDetails": false,
    "layout": "month_view"
  });

  // FAQ accordion
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(function(item){
    const btn = item.querySelector('.faq-question');
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
      document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item.open').forEach(function(open){
        if(open !== item) open.classList.remove('open');
      });
      item.classList.toggle('open', !isOpen);
    });
  });

  // Mobile menu toggle
  const navToggle = document.getElementById('navmenu-toggle');
  const navMobile = document.getElementById('navlinks-mobile');
  navToggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
    const isOpen = navMobile.classList.toggle('open');
    navToggle.classList.toggle('open', isOpen);
    navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
  navMobile.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(link){
    link.addEventListener('click', function(){
      navMobile.classList.remove('open');
      navToggle.classList.remove('open');
      navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  });

  // Scroll fade-in
  const faders = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{ if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('visible'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
  }, {threshold:0.15});
  faders.forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
</script>

</body>
</html>
